name: THE OTHER BOUNDARY MAN
note: Doc 07 #2 and #3, the one doc 07 marks B. Faces A across the forty feet. His barks are carried in A's file as the pair's exchange; he has none of his own (errata 110).

sprite.frameNote: 0 rest, hands on hips, facing A · 1 breath (derived) · 2 points back across the forty feet · 3 argues, one finger up -- TALK. Half a cycle after A (phase 0.5 of the same 10 s), never on his beat.

walkToNote: Beside them at their own depth, not in front (Tyler, 2026-11-07: "Thad's line hit the tops of the heads of the boundary men when he talks to them"). Stood nearer the camera, his words rose from a head lower on the screen than theirs and ran across their hats; level with them, his words sit above all three heads. Was 1700,830. Errata 178: from their right now, at the same depth -- the hitching horses (full-sized, Tyler 2026-11-08) stand in the near mud in front of where their left side was, and a horse's head would have covered him there.
